title: Fernhaven Seed Library — Annual Report 2019 (extract)
text: The catalogue passed six hundred varieties this year, with member-saved seed accounting for most new accessions. The library continues to be run entirely by volunteers and carries no paid staff. April's Seedling Swap was again our busiest day of the year. Lending remains free of charge to members.
notes: First-party annual-report register. Sole source for catalogue size and staffing (single-source questions are agreed, not disputed). Corroborates the festival and free lending. Deliberately contains no founding date.
